definitions.gloss: to be optimistic; to take an optimistic view
definitions.explanation: To view a situation positively, expecting a favorable outcome. Often used with caution, implying the optimism may be premature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{楽観|らっかん}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't be too optimistic about the situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{楽観|らっかん}する⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: He has a personality that always takes an optimistic view of things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{景気回復|けいきかいふく}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{楽観|らっかん}できない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: Experts stated that they cannot be optimistic about the economic recovery.

notes:
Interestingly, {楽観|らっかん}する more often appears in negative or cautionary contexts ({楽観|らっかん}できない, {楽観|らっかん}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない) than in purely positive ones. The related adjective {楽観的|らっかんてき}（な） is more common for simply describing an optimistic outlook.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{楽観的|らっかんてき}→楽観的：06090_rakkanteki⟧な⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧: optimistic view
- ⟦{楽観視|らっかんし}→楽観視：19812_rakkanshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to view optimistically (often in warnings)
- {楽観|らっかん}できる⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: a situation one can be optimistic about
- ⟦{楽観論|らっかんろん}→楽観論：30517_rakkanron⟧: optimistic argument/theory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲観|ひかん}→悲観：22397_hikan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be pessimistic — the antonym
- {楽観的|らっかんてき}（な）: optimistic (adjective) — more common than the verb form for describing personality or outlook
- ⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧な: positive; forward-looking — a more casual, encouraging way to describe optimism
